stockDetail.overview: Zensho Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food industry. The Company has six segments. The Global Sukiya segment operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya domestically and overseas. The Global Hama Sushi segment operates the sushi chain Hama Sushi domestically and overseas. The Global Fast Food segment operates various fast food businesses, including takeout sushi, domestically and overseas. The Restaurant segment operates the restaurant business domestically and overseas. The Retail segment operates supermarkets, etc. The Headquarters and Support segment provides support services for each business type. Other businesses are mainly external sales manufacturing and wholesale, nursing care, and livestock and fisheries businesses.
